Screen checkConfirm in Vanderbilt's Oracle or UKG during a recorded demo: the Individual Compensation quick action name; plan names (Lump sum payment, Bonus, staff supplements); the Net, Amount, Process separately, and Ongoing field labels; that a regular HCM (not a super-user) sees Our Workforce and this quick action.

1 · Intro

When to use it.

Additional compensation is any pay above salary or the regular rate of pay. Grossed up means the employee takes home an exact amount: you enter the net amount and Oracle works out the gross to cover taxes. Example: a $500 net at-home office payment.

Start from the Quick Action, or search the employee's name and open the action from their record. Both reach the same screen.

Use this whenThe employee should take home an exact amount of additional compensation.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Before you submit

The same four checks on every pay-impacting transaction. Draft: the owner for this area confirms anything marked To confirm.

Attach

  • The manager's request (email or memo), saying what the payment is for Attach

Check

Read every field back against the source document: person, effective date, position, hours, pay, and costing.

  • Plan is Lump sum payment.
  • The amount is in Net, not Amount. Net is take-home.
  • Start date is the first day of the target payroll month. Past the cutoff, date it for next month.
  • Process separately is left at Yes unless payroll tells you otherwise.

Cutoff

Monthly (exempt) pay: the change must be fully approved by the HCM Transaction Cutoff, the 18th in most months and earlier in December. Check the HR/Payroll Calendar. Pending approvals do not pay. A change still waiting in approvals at the cutoff misses that payroll.

Who does what

  • Who starts it: You.
  • Who approves: To confirm: the approval chain for this transaction.
  • What happens next: Oracle works out the gross. Pay goes to direct deposit.

Watch-outs

  • Missed the cutoff (around the 18th)? Date it for next month.
  • Only change Process separately if payroll tells you to.
  • Pay goes to direct deposit, which is required.
  • Set the effective as-of date in Individual Compensation before you search for the employee. Otherwise you can't pick an earlier start date.
  • Attach the manager's request (email or memo) and say what the payment is for, so the approver doesn't send it back.
  • Open item: how you know when to ask payroll about Process separately.
  • Open item: confirm with payroll that two payments for the same month can't be on the same assignment.

3 · Knowledge check

Check your understanding.

Three questions. You get feedback on each answer. All three right completes the course.

Q1Which field do you use for a fixed take-home amount?

Q2You want the payment on the November check. What start date?

Q3What does Process separately = Yes do?

Keep it handy.

A one-page version of the steps and watch-outs. Print it or save it as a PDF.

HCM Academy job aid · Compensation Management

Process grossed-up additional compensation

Use when: The employee should take home an exact amount of additional compensation. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Open Individual Compensation for the employee.
    • Or: Quick Actions > Individual Compensation > select the employee.
  2. Click Add, then choose One-time or recurring payment.
  3. Plan: Lump sum payment.
  4. Start date: the first day of the target payroll month.
  5. Enter the amount in the Net field (for example, $500).
  6. Leave Process separately set to Yes.
  7. Click Save.
  8. Click Continue, add comments and documentation, then Submit.

Before you submit

  • Attach: The manager's request (email or memo), saying what the payment is for (attach).
  • Check: Plan is Lump sum payment. The amount is in Net, not Amount. Net is take-home. Start date is the first day of the target payroll month. Past the cutoff, date it for next month. Process separately is left at Yes unless payroll tells you otherwise.
  • Cutoff: Fully approved by the HCM Transaction Cutoff (the 18th in most months, earlier in December). Pending approvals do not pay.

Watch-outs

  • Missed the cutoff (around the 18th)? Date it for next month.
  • Only change Process separately if payroll tells you to.
  • Pay goes to direct deposit, which is required.
  • Set the effective as-of date in Individual Compensation before you search for the employee. Otherwise you can't pick an earlier start date.
  • Attach the manager's request (email or memo) and say what the payment is for, so the approver doesn't send it back.
  • Open item: how you know when to ask payroll about Process separately.
  • Open item: confirm with payroll that two payments for the same month can't be on the same assignment.
